params.name: filter[created]
params.description: ISO dateformat expected. The time when the support ticket was created.

params.name: filter[updated]
params.description: ISO dateformat expected. The time when the support ticket was updated.

params.name: filter[type]
params.description: The type of the support ticket.

params.name: filter[priority]
params.description: The priority of the support ticket.

params.name: filter[status]
params.description: The status of the support ticket.

params.name: filter[requester_id]
params.description: UUID of the ticket requester. Converted from the ZID value.

params.name: filter[submitter_id]
params.description: UUID of the ticket submitter. Converted from the ZID value.

params.name: filter[assignee_id]
params.description: UUID of the ticket assignee. Converted from the ZID value.

params.name: filter[has_incidents]
params.description: Whether or not this ticket has incidents.

params.name: filter[due]
params.description: ISO dateformat expected. A time that the ticket is due at.

params.name: search
params.description: Search string for the ticket subject and description.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to be displayed. Defaults to 1.
